title: Green beginnings: creating an affordable advanced enquiry-based experimental nanochemistry learning module with catalytically active ‘green’ iron oxide nanoparticles (IONPs)
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,3437-3447
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00083A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Timothy Schwantes, Dylan Medina, Brittney Morgan, Abhinandan Banerjee
In an affordable, scalable, and ‘green’ inaugural experiment for a nanochemistry teaching laboratory course, students examine surface-capped iron oxide nanoparticles as model catalysts for a Fenton-like dye degradation reaction in water.
